// Generated by scripts/configure-native.mjs from native/call-session/ios-bridge.swift.txt.
// Do not edit this block in the generated iOS project. Edit the template instead.
import AVFAudio

@objc(LoveRadarNativeCall)
public class LoveRadarNativeCall: CAPPlugin, CAPBridgedPlugin {
    public let identifier = "LoveRadarNativeCall"
    public let jsName = "NativeCall"
    public let pluginMethods: [CAPPluginMethod] = [
        CAPPluginMethod(name: "beginCall", returnType: CAPPluginReturnPromise),
        CAPPluginMethod(name: "endCall", returnType: CAPPluginReturnPromise)
    ]
    private var activeCallId: String?
    private var activeToken: String?
    private var heartbeatTimer: DispatchSourceTimer?
    private let endpoint = URL(string: "https://love-radar-acd.pages.dev/api/call")!

    @objc public func beginCall(_ call: CAPPluginCall) {
        guard let id = call.getString("id"), UUID(uuidString: id) != nil,
              let token = call.getString("token"),
              token.range(of: "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", options: .regularExpression) != nil else {
            call.reject("Appel ou session invalide.")
            return
        }
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            do {
                let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
                try session.setCategory(.playAndRecord, mode: .voiceChat, options: [.allowBluetooth])
                try session.setActive(true)
                if self.activeCallId != id || self.activeToken != token {
                    self.stopTimer()
                    self.activeCallId = id
                    self.activeToken = token
                    self.startTimer()
                }
                call.resolve(["active": true])
            } catch {
                call.reject("Impossible de préparer l'audio de cet iPhone.", nil, error)
            }
        }
    }

    @objc public func endCall(_ call: CAPPluginCall) {
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.finishCall()
            call.resolve()
        }
    }

    private func startTimer() {
        let timer = DispatchSource.makeTimerSource(queue: DispatchQueue.global(qos: .utility))
        timer.schedule(deadline: .now(), repeating: .seconds(24), leeway: .seconds(2))
        timer.setEventHandler { [weak self] in self?.sendHeartbeat() }
        heartbeatTimer = timer
        timer.resume()
    }

    private func sendHeartbeat() {
        // The session is only used during an explicitly active call. It is
        // never persisted, logged or placed into a system notification.
        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
            guard let self = self, let id = self.activeCallId,
                  let token = self.activeToken else { return }
            var request = URLRequest(url: self.endpoint)
            request.httpMethod = "POST"
            request.timeoutInterval = 9
            request.setValue("Bearer " + token, forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
            request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
            request.httpBody = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ["action": "heartbeat", "id": id])
            URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { [weak self] _, response, _ in
                let status = (response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode ?? 0
                if status == 401 || status == 409 {
                    DispatchQueue.main.async {
                        if self?.activeCallId == id { self?.finishCall() }
                    }
                }
            }.resume()
        }
    }

    private func stopTimer() {
        heartbeatTimer?.cancel()
        heartbeatTimer = nil
    }

    private func finishCall() {
        stopTimer()
        activeCallId = nil
        activeToken = nil
        try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(
            false, options: [.notifyOthersOnDeactivation])
    }

    deinit { heartbeatTimer?.cancel() }
}

class LoveRadarBridgeViewController: CAPBridgeViewController {
    override func capacitorDidLoad() {
        super.capacitorDidLoad()
        bridge?.registerPluginInstance(LoveRadarNativeCall())
    }
}
// END LOVE RADAR NATIVE CALL
